nodes.description: Mapping address => uint holding token balances, written on every transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint used by approve/transferFrom.
Total token supply fixed at 9000000000 * 10 ** 18, assigned to deployer in constructor.
Token name string 'GANGNOMIC'.
Token symbol string 'GANGNOMIC'.
Token decimals, fixed at 18.
Constructor that mints the whole totalSupply to msg.sender.
Public view returning balances[owner]; used internally by transfer and transferFrom for the balance check.
Public transfer that moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' and emits Transfer.
Public transferFrom that checks balance and allowance and moves tokens, without decrementing the allowance.
Public approve that sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value and emits Approval.
Caller-controlled address used as owner in constructor/transfer/approve and as spender in transferFrom.
balances[to] += value and balances[msg.sender] -= value inside transfer (arithmetic balance mutation).
balances[to] += value and balances[from] -= value inside transferFrom with a non-decrementing allowance check.
Parameter owner of balanceOf, used as mapping key into balances.
Parameter to of transfer, destination of the credit.
Parameter value of transfer, amount moved.
Parameter from of transferFrom, source of the debit.
Parameter to of transferFrom, destination of the credit.
Parameter value of transferFrom, amount moved.
Parameter spender of approve, key of the allowance mapping.
Parameter value of approve, amount of allowance granted.

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire totalSupply as initial balance in the constructor.
msg.sender is the debited owner and the caller of transfer.
msg.sender acts as spender for the allowance check and as caller of transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key when approving a spender.
transfer executes the balance addition and subtraction on the balances mapping.
transferFrom executes the balance addition and subtraction on the balances mapping.
transfer calls balanceOf(msg.sender) for the pre-condition check.
transferFrom calls balanceOf(from) for the pre-condition check.
The 'to' parameter is used as the credited key balances[to] in transfer.
The caller-supplied 'value' parameter is added and subtracted to balances in transfer.
balances state variable is read and written by transfer.
The 'from' parameter is used as the debited key balances[from] in transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is used as the credited key balances[to] in transferFrom.
The caller-supplied 'value' parameter is added and subtracted to balances in transferFrom.
balances state variable is read and written by transferFrom.
allowance[from][msg.sender] is only checked and never decremented, letting a spender spend their allowance repeatedly.
balanceOf reads balances[owner] directly.
The owner parameter indexes the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
The spender parameter becomes the approved address in allowance[msg.sender][spender].
The value parameter is stored as the granted allowance in approve.
approve writes into the allowance state variable.
